records.quote: caput Ikap- capudh itis {all sing.  regularly capiic: capiti, Cat. 68, 124: cf.  Tib. 1, 1, 72 Huschk., where the MSS, as  well as Caes. German. Aral. 213, vary be-  tween the two forms), n. [kindr. with  Sanscr. kap-ula; Gr. Ke<p-a\ti; Goth, hau-  bith ; Germ. Haupt]. I. The head, of men
records.entryNote: Headword line 100207 "caput ... itis" + etymology bracket + the primary gloss "The head, of men and animals" at 100213.

note: L&S caput, -itis, n. 直接释义 "The head, of men and animals"，与 caput / capitis「头」完全一致；capital、captain 的 capit- 词干由此而来。
